verdict.rationale: Bugbot has built-in event triggers (auto-review on every PR update, manual `bugbot run` comment trigger) and lets users customize behavior via `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` guidelines and natural-language effort-level rules, which function as a limited rule-to-action automation. However this is scoped narrowly to PR review actions rather than a general-purpose rule engine for arbitrary actions on arbitrary events. Missing for 10: evidence of user-defined custom triggers/conditions beyond PR events, ability to chain or trigger non-review actions, and independent confirmation that BUGBOT.md rules reliably alter automatic behavior.
